## Session Context (Teleoperator MCP)

You have access to a WebXR teleoperation gateway for fleet robots.
Pose streams via WebSocket at 30 Hz; MCP tools handle supervision.

**Before starting work:**
1. Check session: teleop_status()
2. Check video: teleop_livekit_status()
3. Verify robot: GET /api/v1/robots

**At end of work:**
- Verify estop is clear if safe: teleop_estop() (stops ALL actuators)
- Set mode back to DIRECT if AUTO was in use: teleop_set_mode(group, mode, confirm_bench)
